parsed.main_gap: Lemma 1's stated general form rests on a false 'infinite sunflower' fact whose inductive proof need not terminate; only the bounded-size case (used later) is genuinely provable, and the write-up doesn't restrict to it.

errors.description: The quoted sunflower fact is false for families of unbounded set size (e.g. a nested/antichain family X_n = {1,...,n} ∪ {n'} has no infinite Δ-system), and the sketched induction ('delete that element, and continue') has no termination argument. Hence Lemma 1 as stated is unproved (and, if true, would trivialize the problem). Only the 'in particular' bounded-size case is actually applied, and there the same induction works once one restricts to sets of size ≤ K — a one-line repair.
